items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I can't say. Ask him, did he know Theo Gene Bakke?

ctx.x: I can't say. Ask him, did he know Theo Gene Bakke?

Is that how you pronounce his name? Theo Gene? No, no, the old man, the father. Theo Gene. Do you know Theo Gene Bakke? Oh yes. He was the Excelsior Band's leader. He had a good band. And what did he play?
